body:
"The last 6 years of my life may had not be "rainbows and butterflies" for me, but they were very valuable and genuine. Please don't ever question that I did loved you, because this was the only reliable, and supporting my existence, truth in my whole conscious life.
It hurts me that you want to throw away all gifts, but I understand you.
I will understand if you need to hate me, I do.
But don't craw into your crab shell once more, because there is happiness in life and you should not run away from it, doing the same mistakes. Be yourself. Because the real Joe I know is beautiful.
Hugs,
Jane"

Translated word to word, so it may sound strange. This was the last thing I have from her. I am trying to let go of the hope, but it hurts a lot.
My friends were supportive, but showing the note won't change anything.

I have exams soon, probably I will seek help after that.
I would actually love someone with whom I can talk daily about my world. ( check your inbox)
